title: Observability: backup graceful N/A (durable state elsewhere)
description: Runs `nexus backup take observability`. The verb returns an actionable N/A: every piece of durable state already has its own recovery story (Loki/Tempo -> MinIO erasure-coded; Grafana DB -> streaming-replicated PG RPO~0; dashboards -> provisioned-as-code; Prom TSDB ephemeral).

observe.what: an actionable N/A explaining where each piece of state is already durable/reproducible

whatProves: ObservabilityAdapter.BackupTakeAsync graceful-N/As: nothing is adapter-ownable to snapshot that is not already durable (MinIO EC + PG repl) or reproducible (dashboards-as-code).
